title: Paginated action menus (p1/2, p2/2) sometimes shifted the numbering of a just-used action (e.g. 'use dried herbs' silently consumed the item on a page where I meant to pick a different numbered option), leading to an accidental item use.
where: The Kings' Rest — the Old Court, menu pagination
